title: Test PushVerification rejects non-Id pushSubscriptionId (RFC 8620 erratum 9268)
description: RFC 8620 erratum 9268 (Matt Diephouse, 2026-11-05, Neil: should be verified) changes section 7.2.2 pushSubscriptionId from String to Id. crate-jmap-types already types it as Id (push.rs:274, validated on deserialize, id.rs:33-43) and the RFC example round-trips (tests/push_types.rs:55-69). Add a negative test (e.g. 'has space' fails) and cite eid9268 in the field doc comment.
close_reason: Added push_verification_rejects_non_id_push_subscription_id test; rustdoc cites erratum 9268 (code already correct). main: bd1b6c75
